newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Beef weak but packers need cattle. Also, further rolling seen.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Higher corn futures indication seen offsetting higher index.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to up 0.200 cent. Further liquidation in April, Taiwan supportive but mixed trade likely ahead of Hog and Pig report.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to up 0.200 cent. Cash lower but trade seen choppy ahead of report.
